prompt:
Create `tzutil.py` (Python 3.12 standard library only: `datetime` and `zoneinfo`) that converts between local wall-clock times and instants correctly across daylight saving time transitions. See README.md. Zone names are IANA names such as `America/New_York`; an unknown name raises `zoneinfo.ZoneInfoNotFoundError`. Nothing may depend on the machine's local timezone.

Implement:
- `class NonexistentTimeError(ValueError)` and `class AmbiguousTimeError(ValueError)`.
- `localize(naive, tz_name, ambiguous="earlier") -> datetime`: attach the zone to a naive `datetime` and return an aware datetime showing the same wall time.
  - If that wall time does not exist in the zone (it is skipped when clocks jump forward), raise `NonexistentTimeError`.
  - If it happens twice (clocks moved back), `ambiguous="earlier"` returns the first occurrence, `"later"` the second, and `"raise"` raises `AmbiguousTimeError`.
  - Any other `ambiguous` value raises `ValueError`; so does an aware (non-naive) input.
- `daily_at(hhmm, tz_name, start, days) -> list[datetime]`: for each of the `days` consecutive local dates beginning at `start` (a `date`), the instant at which the local clock shows `hhmm`, returned as aware datetimes in UTC (offset zero), in date order.
  - If the wall time does not exist that day, use the instant that is the same distance past the jump: e.g. `02:30` on a day when clocks jump from 02:00 to 03:00 becomes 03:30 local time. Some zones jump by 30 minutes, not an hour.
  - If the wall time happens twice that day, use the earlier occurrence.
  - `hhmm` must be exactly two digits, a colon and two digits forming a valid time (`00:00` to `23:59`); otherwise raise `ValueError`. `days` below 0 raises `ValueError`; `days == 0` returns `[]`.
- `elapsed(start, end, tz_name) -> timedelta`: the real time that passes between two naive local wall times in the zone (ambiguous times use the earlier occurrence; a nonexistent time raises `NonexistentTimeError`). It is negative when `end` is before `start`. Example: from 00:00 to 04:00 on the day New York springs forward is 3 hours.
- `format_local(instant, tz_name) -> str`: render an aware datetime as local time in the zone, ISO-8601 with whole seconds (drop microseconds) and the UTC offset, e.g. `2026-03-08T03:30:00-04:00`. A naive input raises `ValueError`.
